title: Crooked Wand of Fireballs
summary: This single-use wand casts 8d6 Fire within a 13 ft radius at 5 ft range.

fields.Cast: Action, choose a target within 5 ft. Deal 8d6 Fire to creatures within 13 ft of the target, Dexterity save for half. The item source does not specify a fixed DC.
fields.After use: Becomes the Broken Wand of Fireballs. The source reports that Evocation Wizards spare themselves and allies.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details and pinned item and rules evidence.
